title: Orange Events App Home and Detail
whatItIs: Two white phones with orange accents: a home with location, search, category circles and event cards with photos, and an event detail with a hero photo, teaser video button, attendee avatars, organizer and a big Book Now bar.
whatItMeans: Orange on white feels lively and social, and warm event photos carry the mood.
techniques: Orange for icons, tags and the main button
Circular category icons in pale orange
Hero photo with overlaid teaser video pill
Attendee avatar stack with a plus count
Sticky bottom bar with price and CTA
bestFor: Light UI with a warm accent

vocabulary.definition: A round icon button for a content category.
A bottom bar with price and action that stays visible.
